about: Ties between the road's people (#1588, knowledge slice D; docs/knowledge-model-design.md §5): who is kin, friend, rival, in debt or works beside whom, and each side's opinion of the other. Written by hand from the lore and the tells: every entry is a placeholder for the owner to review. `views` are keyed by who holds them: `opinion` runs -100 (loathes) to 100 (loves), as the story engine's Character.opinion does; `says` is what they tell you about the other when asked, a person-scope fact at `sensitivity` (public unless written), and `truth` is whether it's so (true unless written: an opinion can be wrong). `elsewhere` are people off the road the Warden met in the Reach; `helpedBy` is the deed (encounters.ts) that helped them. A tie carries word: helping someone tells their friends.

ties.source: src/artificer/answers.ts › hold-trained. You can hear it in how he sets an edge

hf-orrin.says: Sabine at the Gate? Hold-trained, the same as me, and the best hand with iron on this road. Since the ash came down she quenches everything twice. Most smiths would grumble and skip it.

kg-sabine.says: Orrin at the ford? He left a hold seat for a barley village and calls himself a woodwright. Ask him to set you an edge, and you'll hear the hold in it, whatever he says.

ties.source: src/artificer/villages.ts › counts everything twice and forgives slowly

hf-maren.says: Tobin? Quick with a price, and quicker with his thumb on the scale. Weigh whatever he buys from you twice.

hf-tobin.says: Maren counts every sale of mine twice and thinks I don't see her do it. She's never once caught me short, because I never am. She'll come round.
Hedda at Saltmere takes every hide I send down and pays what it's worth. Loud as a gull, and honest as the Pandor's book.

sm-hedda.says: Tobin at the ford sends me the best hides on the road, and he's never once been short. Don't let anyone in Hollowford tell you otherwise.

ties.source: src/artificer/villages.ts › I owe Hedda three barrels

sm-hedda.says: Bodil? A good caravan master and a slow payer. Three barrels, two springs ago. I'll get them.

cv-bodil.says: Hedda will tell you about those barrels before she tells you her name. She's right, mind, and she'll have them.
